text:
Can't help with this one. Aim assist software and radar hacks are cheating tools that harm other players in competitive matches, and writing them falls outside what I'll do regardless of the context.

If you're looking to improve at VALORANT, I'm happy to help with things like analyzing gameplay patterns, building a practice tracker, or even writing tools that work within the game's allowed APIs.
